status: test IPA; await owner iPad acceptance before the 1.0.0 release
changes: Keep the only terminal UIKit host stable while minimizing; resign focus before publishing the hidden layout and defer focus requests outside SwiftUI updates.
Preserve manual keyboard dismissal across ordinary redraws.
Sample host process CPU on the existing timer every two seconds; leave the 48-point corner resize hit area invisible.
Expose wl_data_device_manager v3, data sources and selection offers so original GTK3 creates its default seat.
Carry clipboard pipe FDs across guest/native SCM_RIGHTS with bounded, coordinator-owned nonblocking relays.
Read and write the iPad text clipboard automatically through the existing bridge; read permission remains controlled by iPadOS, with no additional app consent sheet.
Implement virtual scheduling/nice metadata and single-node get_mempolicy subsets used by imv.

apple.step: Validate affected native modules or the complete Apple core
apple.note: The later UI/build portion was superseded and cancelled; reuse only this completed native step.

native_validation.gtk: Original host GTK3 and mousepad, real seat/keyboard/pointer, SHM window and bidirectional Unicode text clipboard; no mocked GTK or seat.
native_validation.reuse_reason: Native sources, Cargo manifests/lock, vendored sources and toolchain match the validated commit. CI verifies the diff and completed steps before reusing results.

reused_guest_inputs.reason: Guest sources and build inputs are unchanged; the successful baseline artifacts are downloaded and checked against their manifests.

limitations: Clipboard is UTF-8 text only, up to the existing 16 KiB bridge limit; no image clipboard or drag-and-drop.
The global Native Bridge setting disables new host clipboard requests as well as other bridge methods. Other native capabilities retain their existing consent flow.
Scheduling policy and nice values are guest metadata; host worker scheduling is unchanged. Real-time policies and RLIMIT_NICE privilege raising remain unsupported.
get_mempolicy models node 0 and MPOL_DEFAULT; no non-default NUMA allocation policy.
Compatibility CSV/JSON were updated for the targeted syscall work; the full syscall probe and unrelated CPU/network/container suites were not rerun.
pending: Owner iPad reproduction: sole Alpine float/minimize/restore, manual keyboard dismissal, hidden resize corner and two-second CPU refresh.
Owner iPad mousepad/imv startup, copy/paste in both directions and the actual iPadOS paste permission prompt.
Owner iPad vkmark display smoothness; simulator GPU completion is not physical presentation acceptance.
Intermittent disappearing status bar remains unconfirmed and tracked in issue 27.

reused_frontend_checks.reason: Both individual checks passed. The follow-up changes terminal focus reentrancy, not clipboard key translation or canvas resize/configure logic; the failed focus invariant and other focus-dependent checks are rerun.

notes: The real Alpine UI flow passed before a stronger single-terminal focus invariant exposed stale SwiftUI visibility snapshots. The final fix queries the live workspace both when applying the UIView update and when UIKit asks whether a terminal may become first responder. It also ignores reentrant transition requests, preserves manual keyboard dismissal and invalidates queued restoration on resign. The failed invariant runs first, followed by focus-dependent tests.
Validation records are committed with [skip ci] after the built app is verified; no extra build is triggered for bookkeeping.
